product.title: London River Cruise & Westminster Walking Tour

description.text: See London's most famous landmarks on a half-day tour that combines a Westminster walking tour with a Thames River sightseeing cruise. Skip the hassle of navigating as you follow your guide past attractions such as Buckingham Palace, Trafalgar Square, Big Ben, and Westminster Abbey. Stops include Buckingham Palace, Trafalgar Square, Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, Thames River. The walking tour ends with drop-off at the Thames River cruise for another perspective on London from the water. Ideal for visitors basing in London who want a guided city experience without coordinating Tube routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
